summary: Chunked iteration helper over an indexed element-pointer array. For a total element count stored at this+0x10 it walks the array in chunks clamped to this+0x14 and bounded by this+0x1C and this+0x4 relative to index+this+0x18. Each chunk is dispatched to one of two cdecl callbacks stored at this+0x28 (default) or this+0x2C (selected by flag a3), passing the destination a2, a state pointer at this+0x28, the current element pointer from the array at *(this+0x0), the base byte offset and the chunk byte count. Breaks early when clamping leaves no elements in the chunk.
